title: Skin Finish Water Based Loose Setting Powder
descriptionHtml:
✓ Good for: Pores✓ Loose Powder Formula✓ Natural Finish✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: A waterbased loose setting powder that leaves your skin looking like skin—it helps to reduce the look of pores, fix makeup, and remove unwanted shine.


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Glycerin: Moisturizes and protects the skin barrier.

- Silica Silylate: Absorbs oil and sebum to remove unwanted shine.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

Unscrew the lid and remove the inner lid. Bounce a beauty sponge (sold separately) lightly on top of the mesh. Dab to apply the product to the face. Skin Finish can be used anywhere on the face but is best used on the Tzone and undereye area. Keep the inner lid on after use to prevent the formula from drying out. For use on top of REFY Face Collection or any face base.


Recycling Instructions:

-All box packaging is fully recyclable.

-Remove the mesh and ensure it is empty of product.

-The component is plastic; it can be recycled in your home plastic recycling bin.

Ingredients+
-Glycerin: Moisturizes and protects the skin barrier.
-Silica Silylate: Absorbs oil and sebum to remove unwanted shine.

Aqua/Water/Eau, Vinyl Dimethicone/Methicone Silsesquioxane Crosspolymer, Glycerin, Silica Silylate, Phenoxyethanol, Hydroxyacetophenone, Caprylyl Glycol, Triethoxycaprylylsilane [+/- May Contain/Peut Contenir: Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499)].
